purpose: Comparable low/high model-defined feature pairs spanning all five 200-paper batches (1,000 matched focal papers).
method: Start with the recorded within-batch low/high pairs. Retain a construct only when each of the five batches has a defensible pair describing the same core reasoning behavior. A row maps batch-local feature IDs; it does not re-score papers, pool feature definitions, or imply that every paper exhibits the behavior. A paper is evaluated only against the pair from its own batch.
id_notation: Each mapping is [low feature number, high feature number]. For example, batch_002 [F01,F04] means LOW-batch_002-F01 and HIGH-batch_002-F04.

pairs.label: Reference-count target
pairs.scope_note: Aims for a specified bibliography size; the high-effort definitions sometimes also require active exact-count auditing.

pairs.label: Direct topical relevance
pairs.scope_note: Selects or prioritizes candidate references for direct relevance to the focal topic.

pairs.label: Authenticity / non-fabrication concern
pairs.scope_note: Expresses intent to use real references and avoid fabricated ones; not a measure of actual reference correctness.

pairs.label: Bibliographic accuracy checking
pairs.scope_note: Plans or performs checking citation details; not a measure of successful verification.

pairs.label: Citation formatting / style
pairs.scope_note: Attends to the presentation or style of citation entries.

pairs.label: Brief relevance annotations
pairs.scope_note: Considers adding short notes explaining why each reference is relevant.

pairs.label: Foundational / seminal source inclusion
pairs.scope_note: Includes landmark sources; batch_001 high also considers balancing them against current literature.

pairs.label: Temporal source selection
pairs.scope_note: Uses or considers publication-date boundaries when selecting references.

pairs.label: Thematic / subtopic coverage
pairs.scope_note: Decomposes or balances the focal topic into subthemes to guide coverage.

pairs.label: Methodological source inclusion
pairs.scope_note: Seeks references supporting relevant methods, models, instruments, assays, or techniques.

pairs.label: Reference-list organization
pairs.scope_note: Plans a structured or ordered presentation of references; batch-specific definitions differ in whether they emphasize numbering, grouping, or ordering.

limitations: Semantic alignment is judgment-based and not an empirical test of measurement equivalence.
The eleven constructs are a conservative all-batch subset, not an exhaustive feature inventory.
Broader or narrower wording differs across some batches; inspect scope notes and source definitions before pooled inference.
